vocabulary.meaning_en: four ideas: downward movement, decrease, stopping, and the end
vocabulary.note_ar: إذا فهمت معاني down سهل عليك فهم أفعالها المركّبة
vocabulary.note_en: Understand the preposition and the phrasal verbs become easier.
vocabulary.example: The price went down from one dollar to fifty cents.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move your body down onto a seat
vocabulary.example: Please sit down; I have some news.

vocabulary.note_ar: معنى: نقصان. وتعني أيضًا يرفض عرضًا
vocabulary.note_en: Idea: decrease. It can also mean refuse an offer.
vocabulary.example: Can you turn down the TV, please?
He waits until the prices come down.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to shout so that a speaker cannot be heard and has to stop
vocabulary.example: The angry crowd shouted down the speaker.
The store went bankrupt and will close down in July.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop working; to turn off a machine or close a business
vocabulary.example: Shut down your computer before you leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a government or leader lose power
vocabulary.example: One bad decision could bring down the government.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (a machine or car) to stop working
vocabulary.example: My car keeps breaking down. I need a new one.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having no money to pay debts, so a business must stop
a drawing that shows ideas connected around a central word
vocabulary.example: James drew a mind map for "down".

fine_lines.title: The four ideas of "down"
fine_lines.explanation_ar: 1) حركة للأسفل: sit down. 2) نقصان: turn down, come down. 3) توقّف: shout down, break down. 4) نهاية: close down, bring down. وهي مترابطة: النزول يعني النقصان، ثم التوقّف، ثم النهاية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 1) Downward movement: sit down. 2) Decrease: turn down, come down. 3) Stopping: shout down, break down. 4) End: close down, bring down. They connect: going down means decreasing, then stopping, then the end.

examples.sentence: We all sat down at the table.
My car broke down on the highway.
The factory closed down last year.

fine_lines.title: close down vs break down
fine_lines.explanation_ar: close down لعمل تجاري يتوقّف نهائيًا. break down لآلة أو سيارة تتعطّل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Close down: a business stops for good. Break down: a machine or car stops working.

expressions.phrase: You should sit down before I tell you this.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن تجلس قبل أن أخبرك بهذا.
expressions.meaning_en: said before giving bad or surprising news
expressions.example: You should sit down before I tell you the bad news.

expressions.phrase: Can you turn down the TV?
expressions.example: The baby is sleeping. Can you turn down the TV?

expressions.phrase: Did you turn down the heat?
expressions.meaning_en: Did you make it less warm?
expressions.example: Did you turn down the heat? It's cold in here.

expressions.phrase: wait until the prices come down
expressions.example: I never buy at full price; I wait until the prices come down.

grammar.title: Learn the preposition first
grammar.explanation_ar: بدل حفظ كل فعل مركّب وحده، افهم معنى حرف الجر. down = نزول ونقصان وتوقّف ونهاية. عندما تسمع فعلًا جديدًا مع down (مثل slow down) يمكنك تخمين معناه: يُبطئ = نقصان في السرعة.
grammar.explanation_en: Instead of memorizing each phrasal verb, learn what the preposition means. Down = downward movement, decrease, stopping, end. When you hear a new one (slow down), you can guess: a decrease in speed.
examples: cut down on sugar = eat less sugar

questions.question: Which is NOT a meaning of "down"?
"You should ___ down before I tell you this bad news."
"The TV is too loud. Can you ___ it down?"
"Bruce didn't like the speech, so he started to ___ down the speaker."
questions.explanation_en: Shout down = stop a speaker by shouting.

questions.question: "The store went bankrupt and will ___ down in July."
"A wrong decision could ___ down the government."
questions.explanation_en: Bring down = make it lose power.

questions.question: "My car keeps ___ down. I need a new car."
"Mr. E waits until the prices ___ down."
